summary.tagline: Abisko National Park (Swedish: Abisko nationalpark) is a National Park in Sweden, established in 1909.

days.title: Rivers, Gorges and Lake Shores
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Torneträsk-See
stops.detail: The national park consists of a valley framed by mountain ranges in the south and west and the Torneträsk lake in the north.

stops.name: Abiskojåkka
stops.detail: The Abiskojåkka river, which runs through the entire park, flows through a gorge about 20 m deep shortly before its mouth.

stops.name: Abisko Turiststation
stops.detail: One of the most important Swedish long-distance hiking trails, the Kungsleden, starts at the Abisko Turiststation, which is also accessible via the railway station of the same name, and leads southwards through the national park.

stops.name: Vuolep Njakajaure
stops.detail: The largest lakes are the Vuolep Njakajaure, Abiskojaure and Påtjojaure.
